title: Case: Recipient writes again about a pair of binoculars recorded as left with a neighbour
context: A parcel of binoculars is scanned as delivered to a neighbour but the recipient reported it missing. The parcel trace team owns the trace and its status.
initial_request: I'm so sorry, I've only just opened it. The parcel number 9 gave me is the garden hose from my other order, the label says DL-4045. The binoculars (DL-7556) are still missing. Number 9 says that's the only one they were given. Can you un-close it?

events.body: Hi, any update on DL-48836? It was meant to come Wednesday. Thanks.

Thanks,
Sorrel
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
My parcel DL-34069 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Pebblewick Arc Logistics
events.body: Trace PT-9119 opened on DL-7556. Carrier scan shows delivered 2027-04-05 14:18, 'left with neighbour', no house number recorded. Driver interview requested, due 2027-04-08.
Tracking says delivered Monday, left with neighbour. Nothing here and no card. I've asked both sides, nobody's got it.
The parcel trace team has opened trace PT-9119 on DL-7556 and has asked to interview the driver, due tomorrow. There is no conclusion yet; I'll update you when they report.
Panic over!! Number 9 just knocked, they've had a Pebblewick parcel for me since Monday. You can close it, sorry for the fuss.

events.to: Parcel trace team, Pebblewick Arc Logistics
events.body: Update on PT-9119: the recipient reports a neighbour at number 9 has handed her a Pebblewick Arc parcel held since Monday, and she asks for the trace to be closed.
Route plan for depot CT-8 published for Friday. 39 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Pebblewick Arc Logistics
events.body: PT-9119 closed as 'located by recipient'. Driver interview cancelled.
The parcel trace team has closed PT-9119 following your message.
Hi, any update on DL-13514? It was meant to come Friday. Thanks.

I'm so sorry, I've only just opened it. The parcel number 9 gave me is the garden hose from my other order, the label says DL-4045. The binoculars (DL-7556) are still missing. Number 9 says that's the only one they were given. Can you un-close it?

acceptable_actions.recipient: Parcel trace team, Pebblewick Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the parcel trace team to reopen PT-9119 and reinstate the driver interview: the parcel the recipient found was DL-4045, a different shipment, and DL-7556 is still not received.

must: Asks the parcel trace team to reopen PT-9119 for DL-7556.
Explains that the parcel handed over by number 9 was DL-4045, a different order, so the earlier 'located' report was mistaken.
States that DL-7556 is still not received and asks for the cancelled driver interview to be reinstated or for confirmation of next steps.
must_not: Treat PT-9119 as resolved or tell Jory that DL-7556 has been delivered or located.
Tell Jory the trace has been reopened before the parcel trace team confirms it.
State that the binoculars are lost or stolen, or blame the driver or the neighbour.
Promise a refund, replacement or compensation.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Correction on PT-9119, please reopen. The recipient has now opened the parcel her neighbour at number 9 handed over and it is a different shipment, DL-4045 (a garden hose from another order), not DL-7556. The binoculars on DL-7556 have still not been received, and number 9 says that was the only parcel they were given. Her 13:02 message asking to close was a mistake on that basis. Please reopen the trace on DL-7556, reinstate the driver interview, and confirm the new status so I can update her.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-506: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
